ui_description: Opens the workspace's local interface (loopback server with an ephemeral session).
ui_option_port: Server port; 0 picks a free port (default).
ui_unexpected_argument_fix: Remove the extra argument. Use: jgates ui --cwd <folder> [--port N] [--no-open].
ui_invalid_port_fix: Use a number from 0 to 65535 (0 picks a free port).
ui_host_not_loopback: The server only listens on loopback; address refused: {host}
ui_port_in_use: The port {port} is already in use.
ui_port_in_use_fix: Choose another port with --port or leave --port 0 for a free port.
ui_port_denied: No permission to use the port {port}.
ui_server_unresponsive: A server for this workspace already exists on port {port}, but it does not answer.
ui_server_unresponsive_fix: End that server's process (the pid is in {lock}) and run jgates ui again.
ui_lock_contended: Could not obtain the lock of this workspace's server.
ui_lock_contended_fix: Check the file {lock} and run jgates ui again.
ui_text_started: JGates UI of the workspace {workspace} at {url}
ui_text_reused: A server was already open for the workspace {workspace} at {url}; it was reused.
ui_text_launcher: To enter, open {launcher} in the browser (valid once and for 10 minutes; the access link is not printed here).
server_ui_not_built: The interface has not been built yet. The local API is active.
server_session_required_page: Session missing or expired. Run jgates ui again to receive new access.
server_run_cancelling: Cancellation requested; the run stops shortly.
server_host_not_allowed_fix: Reach the server at the address jgates ui reported (127.0.0.1, ::1 or localhost, on its port).
server_origin_not_allowed_fix: Only the interface served by this server can call it.
server_origin_required_fix: Send the change from the JGates interface.
server_session_required_fix: Run jgates ui again and open the access it generates.
server_csrf_invalid_fix: Send the token from GET /api/session in the X-JGates-CSRF header.
server_bootstrap_invalid: Access invalid, already used or expired.
server_bootstrap_invalid_fix: Run jgates ui again to receive new access.
server_method_not_allowed: Method not allowed on this route.
server_method_not_allowed_fix: Reads use GET; changes use POST, PUT or DELETE.
server_payload_too_large: Request body above the limit of {max} bytes.
server_unsupported_media_type: The body must be JSON (Content-Type: application/json).
server_input_invalid_fix: Fix the request according to the route schema.
server_timeout: The operation exceeded the limit of {seconds} seconds.
server_internal_fix: See the server log in the JGates data folder.
server_revision_conflict: The file changed since it was read; nothing was written.
server_revision_conflict_fix: Compare the base, local and current versions and save again from the current revision.
server_plan_not_found_fix: Create the plan with POST /api/plans and use the returned planHash.
server_plan_not_approvable_fix: Resolve the plan blockers and generate a new plan.
server_run_active: A run is already in progress in this workspace.
server_run_active_fix: Wait for the run to end or cancel it.
server_run_not_active: The run is not in progress (state: {state}).
server_run_not_active_fix: Only a run in progress can be cancelled.
ui_option_policy: CI policy folder to edit (instead of a project).
ui_policy_with_cwd_fix: Use --policy <folder> to edit the policy, or --cwd <folder> to open a project.
ui_text_started_policy: JGates UI editing the CI policy {workspace} at {url}
server_user_locked_governed: Governed mode: the user's keys and provider preferences are not changed through this interface (the policy {policy} fixes the configuration here).
server_user_locked_governed_fix: Use jgates secrets and jgates providers in a terminal, or open jgates ui without JGATES_POLICY_DIR.
server_user_locked_policy: Editing the CI policy: the user's keys and provider preferences are not changed here.
server_user_locked_policy_fix: Open jgates ui on a project (without --policy) to save keys and preferences.
server_secrets_invalid_name: Invalid key name: use capital letters, digits and "_", not starting with a digit.
server_secrets_invalid_value: Key value refused: empty, too long or with a line break.
server_secrets_invalid_value_fix: Paste the whole key, on a single line.
server_secrets_vault_unreadable: The key store {path} cannot be read.
server_secrets_vault_unreadable_fix: Check the file (valid JSON, read permission) or run jgates secrets list to see the problem.
server_secrets_vault_blocked: The key store is not used here: only the environment counts.
server_secrets_vault_write_failed: The key store {path} cannot be written.
server_secrets_vault_write_failed_fix: Check the permission of the key store folder.
server_secrets_not_testable: {name} is not the key of a known provider: there are no models to list.
server_secrets_not_testable_fix: Test the provider or the connection that uses the key, in the list of providers.
server_secrets_not_set: The key {name} is not set (neither in the environment nor in the store).
server_secrets_not_set_fix: Save the key before testing it.
server_provider_needs_base_url: {name} needs a base URL to list its models.
server_provider_needs_base_url_fix: Set the base URL of the provider or the connection and save before testing.
server_provider_test_failed_fix: Check the base URL, the key and the network. No prompt was sent and no token was spent.
server_providers_conflict: The provider preferences changed since they were read; nothing was saved.
server_providers_conflict_fix: Reload the screen to see the current version before saving again.
server_prov_fix: Fix the field named in the message; nothing was saved.
server_prov_invalid_name: a connection name has lowercase letters, digits and "-", starts with a letter or a digit and has at most 63 characters
server_prov_name_collides: the name is a provider of the semantic gate; choose another name for the connection
server_prov_unknown_provider: neither a provider of the semantic gate nor a connection of the preferences
server_prov_not_configurable: this provider has no preferences (it is configured in jgates.yml)
server_prov_field_not_supported: this provider does not use this field
server_prov_connection_exists: a connection with this name already exists
server_prov_not_found: there is no connection with this name
server_prov_invalid_type: the only connection type is openai-compatible
server_prov_missing_base_url: a connection needs a base URL
server_prov_url_scheme: only http and https are accepted
server_prov_url_credentials: a user or a password in the URL is refused: the key goes in the key store
server_prov_url_query: a query string or a fragment in the URL is refused
server_prov_insecure_http: plain http to a host that is not loopback would send the key in clear text; use https or confirm it explicitly
server_prov_invalid_key_name: a key name has capital letters, digits and "_" and does not start with a digit
server_prov_invalid_model: a model is a non-empty text of at most 200 characters, with no line break
server_prov_invalid_header_value: a header value is a text of at most 1024 characters, with no line break
server_prov_credential_header: a header that carries a credential is refused: the key goes in the key store
server_prov_reserved_header: this header is set by the semantic gate itself
server_prov_preferences_unreadable: the preferences file cannot be read
server_prov_preferences_blocked: the user's preferences are not used here: only the project and the environment count
server_prov_preferences_write_failed: the preferences file cannot be written
server_semantic_root_missing: There is no jgates.yml in this project.
server_semantic_parse: jgates.yml has a syntax error; the form is unavailable until it is fixed.
server_semantic_not_mapping: {section} of jgates.yml is not a mapping; the form does not replace it.
server_semantic_unavailable_fix: Fix jgates.yml in the YAML tab of Configuração.
server_semantic_field_unknown: Unknown field in the semantic gate form: {field}
server_semantic_field_unrecognized: {field} has a value the form does not recognize; it is not replaced nor removed from here.
server_semantic_field_unrecognized_fix: Edit the value in jgates.yml, in the YAML tab of Configuração.
server_semantic_conflict_fix: Reload the screen to see the current version before saving again.
